profile:
COMPANY NAME: Roblox
INDUSTRY: Online Gaming / User-Generated Content Platform
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: A global online platform where users can play, create, and share user-generated games and experiences. It provides a suite of tools for developers to build interactive 3D worlds and a marketplace for players to discover and engage with content.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Gamers of all ages (with a strong focus on younger demographics and families) and game developers/creators ranging from hobbyists to professional studios.
PRICING MODEL: Freemium (Free to play and create; revenue generated through virtual currency "Robux" for in-game purchases and creator monetization)
KEY FEATURES:
- Massive library of user-generated games and experiences
- Roblox Studio: Tools for creating and publishing 3D games
- Generative AI tools to assist creators in building faster
- Age-appropriate content filtering and safety features
- Global infrastructure supporting millions of concurrent users
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS:
- "One-of-a-kind" destination combining gaming and creation
- Thriving community of creators and players
- Pioneering use of AI generation for both creators and users
- Commitment to safety and digital independence for users of all ages
TONE & POSITIONING: Community-focused, innovative, family-friendly, and developer-empowering
